mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookshelf_item (user_id, file_id, display_title, progress_cfi, progress_percent, last_read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileId}, #{displayTitle}, #{progressCfi}, #{progressPercent}, #{lastReadAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.user_id, b.file_id, b.display_title, b.progress_cfi, b.progress_percent, b.last_read_at, b.created_at, f.file_type, f.file_size, f.meta_title, f.meta_author FROM bookshelf_item b LEFT JOIN file_asset f ON b.file_id = f.id WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.user_id, b.file_id, b.display_title, b.progress_cfi, b.progress_percent, b.last_read_at, b.created_at, f.file_type, f.file_size, f.meta_title, f.meta_author FROM bookshelf_item b LEFT JOIN file_asset f ON b.file_id = f.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.file_id = #{fileId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookshelf_item WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
